notes: No byte-parity group on purpose. Unlike the programmer kit, these two profiles must NOT ship identical skills: each states the enforcement reality of its own profile, so the hook-capable copy says covered risky calls stay denied while the hookless copy says the skill cannot block and confirmation must come from the host. Byte-parity would force one of those two truths to be a lie. The cross-profile phrase contract is owned by plugins/test_plugin_profiles.py. The superseded grok-ai-hands package now lives in legacy/, out of the installable plugins/ tree, because it carries a model-supplied allow_destructive bypass; see legacy/README.md.
